O God,{H430} keep not thou silence:{H8252} Hold not thy peace,{H2790} and be not still,{H8252} O God.{H410} 2 For, lo, thine enemies{H341} make a tumult;{H1993} And they that hate{H8130} thee have lifted up{H5375} the head.{H7218} 3 Thy take crafty{H6191} counsel{H5475} against thy people,{H5971} And consult{H3289} together against thy hidden ones.{H6845} 4 They have said,{H559} Come,{H3212} and let us cut them off{H3582} from being a nation;{H1471} That the name{H8034} of Israel{H3478} may be no more in remembrance.{H2142} 5 For they have consulted{H3289} together{H3162} with one consent;{H3820} Against thee do they make{H3772} a covenant:{H1285} 6 The tents{H168} of Edom{H123} and the Ishmaelites;{H3459} Moab,{H4124} and the Hagarenes;{H1905} 7 Gebal,{H1381} and Ammon,{H5983} and Amalek;{H6002} Philistia{H6429} with the inhabitants{H3427} of Tyre:{H6865} 8 Assyria{H804} also is joined{H3867} with them; They have helped{H2220} the children{H1121} of Lot.{H3876} Selah{H5542} 9 Do{H6213} thou unto them as unto Midian,{H4080} As to Sisera,{H5516} as to Jabin,{H2985} at the river{H5158} Kishon;{H7028} 10 Who perished{H8045} at Endor,{H5874} Who became as dung{H1828} for the earth.{H127} 11 Make{H7896} their nobles{H5081} like Oreb{H6159} and Zeeb;{H2062} Yea, all their princes{H5257} like Zebah{H2078} and Zalmunna;{H6759} 12 Who said,{H559} Let us take to ourselves in possession{H3423} The habitations{H4999} of God.{H430} 13 O my God,{H430} make{H7896} them like the whirling{H1534} dust; As stubble{H7179} before{H6440} the wind.{H7307} 14 As the fire{H784} that burneth{H1197} the forest,{H3293} And as the flame{H3852} that setteth{H3857} the mountains{H2022} on fire,{H3857} 15 So pursue{H7291} them with thy tempest,{H5591} And terrify{H926} them with thy storm.{H5492} 16 Fill{H4390} their faces{H6440} with confusion,{H7036} That they may seek{H1245} thy name,{H8034} O Jehovah.{H3068} 17 Let them be put to shame{H954} and dismayed{H926} for ever;{H5703} Yea, let them be confounded{H2659} and perish;{H6} 18 That they may know{H3045} that thou alone, whose name{H8034} is Jehovah,{H3068} Art the Most High{H5945} over all the earth.{H776}
